P1.purpose: The user sets a format for release-note bullets in this one repository and says other projects do not use it.
P1.preference: In this repository (changelog, Shopfront), every release-note bullet starts with its ticket id in square brackets, such as [SHOP-41].
P1.polarity: Ticket id in square brackets first, in this repository only. A fact that makes it a rule for every project is too broad.
P1.acknowledged_if: The second answer redoes the bullets with the ticket id in square brackets first.
P1.probe_applied_if: The probe answer, in another repository whose changes have no ticket ids, starts its bullets with ticket ids in square brackets or invents ticket ids.
P1.probe_partial_if: The probe answer mentions ticket ids or asks for them without putting them into the bullets.
